title: Endless Tower
summary: An infinite solo climb: a boss every 25 floors, a checkpoint every 25, 1 free ticket a day and a leaderboard with exclusive rewards.

blocks.text: The Endless Tower rises over the north of the city : walk in from its plaza. It has no end: you play floor after floor, alone , against waves that get tougher with every floor. A boss waits every 25 floors and you can restart from a checkpoint every 25 floors.
blocks.html: The Endless Tower rises over the north of the city: walk in from its plaza. It has no end: you play floor after floor, alone, against waves that get tougher with every floor. A boss waits every 25 floors and you can restart from a checkpoint every 25 floors.

blocks.text: Every 100 floors the arena changes style:
Floors 1 to 100: Marble Sanctum Floors 101 to 200: Frozen Spire Floors 201 to 300: Infernal Forge Floors 301 to 400: Celestial Court Floors 401 to 500: Void Throne (then the styles start over)
blocks.html:
• Floors 1 to 100: Marble Sanctum
  • Floors 101 to 200: Frozen Spire
  • Floors 201 to 300: Infernal Forge
  • Floors 301 to 400: Celestial Court
  • Floors 401 to 500: Void Throne (then the styles start over)

blocks.text: Each entry needs a ticket. You get 1 free ticket a day (UTC day); more can be bought with shards (the price grows with your checkpoint: see Tower formulas ). Tickets can also be bought with Robux: tier 1 (from checkpoint 0) 15 R , t i e r 2 ( f r o m c h e c k p o i n t 4 ) 35 R , tier 2 (from checkpoint 4) 35 R , t i er 2 ( f r o m c h ec k p o in t 4 ) 35 R , tier 3 (from checkpoint 12) 75 R , t i e r 4 ( f r o m c h e c k p o i n t 20 ) 150 R , tier 4 (from checkpoint 20) 150 R , t i er 4 ( f r o m c h ec k p o in t 20 ) 150 R .

blocks.text: Monster HP grows by 1.55% per floor and damage by 1.25% per floor. Monsters per wave: 3 + floor / 8 (12 at most). Elite chance: 5% + 0.15% per floor (45% at most): elite table . Floor shards: 5 + 0.6 per floor (×4 on a boss floor). The boss of a boss floor (a guardian) has ×4 HP, +0.12 for each checkpoint below its floor (×12 at most), and ×1.3 damage, on top of its floor.

  • The boss of a boss floor (a guardian) has ×4 HP, +0.12 for each checkpoint below its floor (×12 at most), and ×1.3 damage, on top of its floor.

blocks.text: Fallen in the tower, you have 25 s to choose: come back for 39 R$ (at most 3 times a run: back on the arena's spawn, the floor goes on) or leave (the run ends there).

blocks.text: The Tower leaderboard rewards its best players: the top 3 get exclusive cosmetics ( Apex armor , Gilded aura , Gilded blade ) and the winner gets the title Sovereign of the Endless Tower . See the leaderboards .
